prompt: We're genotyping an autotetraploid potato GWAS panel with GBS and phenotyping it in field trials at two sites over two years, two replicates per site, scoring tuber yield, dry matter, common scab and a dozen other traits. How should the trials be laid out?
paper_design: GWAS panel, 2012-2013, 2 sites, 2 reps per environment, ~19 traits

prompt: small rna seq on zebrafish testis, GH transgenic males vs wild type, 10 fish per group taken from two tanks each. whats the right replicate here
paper_design: GH-transgenic vs non-transgenic, 10 males/group (5 per aquarium), 15 months, testes miRNA-seq

prompt: 5-wk-old pigs: direct-fed microbial in feed vs none, challenged with Salmonella alone or Salmonella + PRRSV, 4 pigs per group. 16S of gut digesta and mucosa. Design?
paper_design: DFM x challenge (Sc vs Sc+PRRSV) + unchallenged control, 4 pigs/group, 16S digesta

prompt: Planning single-cell RNA-seq atlases of soybean (Williams 82) roots and mature nodules, 28 days after Bradyrhizobium inoculation, plants grown in a growth chamber. How many biological replicates and cells per sample do I need?
paper_design: scRNA-seq root + nodule atlases, growth chamber, 3 bio reps

prompt: If we collect symptomatic tomato leaves from commercial fields across Sicily every year and pool 20 plants per field for nanopore sequencing of the begomovirus population, how many fields per year do we need?
paper_design: field survey 1994-2022, 20 symptomatic plants pooled per field

prompt: we have one cloned pig and its donor pig, want to do WGBS on blood and ear fibroblasts to look at epigenetic diffrences. is one animal each enough or not
paper_design: cloned vs donor pig, 1 each, WGBS of blood and ear fibroblast

prompt: TRAP-seq of Arabidopsis flowers: HF-RPL18 lines under cell-type promoters, inflorescences collected 3 and 5 days after dexamethasone induction. Replicates?
paper_design: cell-type TRAP in flowers, 3/5 d after dex, 2 pooled sets per replicate

prompt: Arabidopsis in the greenhouse: I pre-treat 17-day-old plants with ethanol at 0, 5, 10 or 20 mM for 3 days and then withhold water. Six pots per treatment with four plants per pot, and I'll repeat the whole experiment three times. What's my experimental unit?
paper_design: ethanol 0/5/10/20 mM then drought, 6 pots x 4 plants per treatment, 3 experimental replications

prompt: We want to knock out a fruit-specific carotenoid gene in blood oranges with CRISPR: Agrobacterium transformation of epicotyl explants from 4 pigmented cultivars, shoots micrografted onto Carrizo, then amplicon sequencing of the target site to check edits. What controls do I need?
paper_design: dual sgRNA CRISPR on beta-cyclase 2 in 5 blood orange cvs, amplicon-seq of edits

prompt: Running scATAC-seq on zebrafish retinas during ganglion cell regeneration after NTR/metronidazole ablation, with 3 biological replicates per timepoint. How many timepoints and nuclei per sample?
paper_design: scATAC of regenerating retina, 3 bio reps

prompt: MeDIP-seq of red blood cells from male White Leghorn chickens raised in two different biomes. In each, half the birds get daily social-isolation stress from day 4 to 26 and the rest are controls, 16 birds per group at the larger site. How do I analyse biome x stress?
paper_design: 2 biomes (SW 8 stressed/6 control, BR 16/16), MeDIP of RBCs

prompt: Male F344 rats on control feed or feed containing aflatoxin B1, for 14 or 90 days, 6 rats per group housed 3 per cage. At the end, liver RNA-seq and exome sequencing. Where's my experimental unit?
paper_design: AFB1 0.1 mg/kg/day in feed, 14 or 90 d, 6/group, 3 per cage

prompt: We have a soybean fast-neutron mutant population (M5 to M11 generations of M92-220) grown in one field, and want to find copy-number changes using GBS read depth against wild-type plants. How many wild-type plants do we need as controls?
paper_design: fast-neutron mutants, field 2016, WT M92-220 controls

prompt: Lung cancer xenografts: A549 cells injected into 6-week-old male nude mice, then vehicle vs two inhibitors, 8 mice per group, tumour volume tracked for 25 days. Is 8 per group enough?
paper_design: xenograft, vehicle/J10/RK-33, 8 mice/group; MeRIP in A549 cells

prompt: small rna seq of arabidopsis col-0 leaves infected with 2 viruses (ORMV and TMV-Cg) plus mock, pooling 5 plants per sample and 2 bio reps per treatment, in a growth chamber. enough reps??
paper_design: mock/ORMV/TMV-Cg, 5 plants pooled, 2 bio reps, growth chamber

prompt: Hi-C on C. elegans L3 larvae: heat-shock-induced TEV cleavage of cohesin vs a TEV-only control, both heat-shocked. How many biological replicates?
paper_design: cohesin cleavage vs TEV control, L3, Hi-C

prompt: Barley Golden Promise seedlings in hydroponics in a growth chamber get an auxin treatment; I sample the stem base at 0, 3, 6, 9 and 24 h for ATAC-seq and RNA-seq, 3 biological replicates each pooled from 5 seedlings.
paper_design: auxin time course 0-24 h, stem base, 3 reps of 5 pooled seedlings

prompt: Setaria viridis drm1ab mutant vs WT, whole-genome bisulfite sequencing of leaves at 5 weeks, growth chamber, 3 reps each pooled from 4 plants.
paper_design: drm1ab vs WT, WGBS leaf, 3 reps pooled from 4 plants

prompt: For MeDIP-seq in 22RV1 prostate cancer cells treated with a CDK12/13 inhibitor vs DMSO, with 4 biological replicates, do I also need technical replicates?
paper_design: THZ531 vs DMSO, MeDIP, 4 bio reps, 3 tech reps

prompt: I'm sequencing individual plants from european maize landrace populations grown in field plots, somewhere between 3 and 10 plants per population, to link genotype to local adaptation. how many plants per population should i aim for
paper_design: 3-10 plants per landrace population sampled per plot, WGS

prompt: Is 4 biological replicates enough to compare rRNA modification profiles by sequencing between yeast snoRNP mutants lacking their lysine-rich domains and wild type, grown at 30 C?
paper_design: KKE/D domain mutants vs WT, 4 bio reps

prompt: Can I call breed differences from ChIP-seq of H3K27ac and H3K4me3 in pituitary glands of two pig breeds, Bama Xiang and Large White, with 2 animals per breed?
paper_design: 2 breeds x 2 full-sib animals, pituitary ChIP-seq

prompt: Potato leaves inoculated with Phytophthora infestans or water, sampled 5 days post-inoculation, for small RNA and degradome (PARE) sequencing, with 3 replicates of pooled leaf material per treatment.
paper_design: P. infestans vs water, 5 dpi, 3 reps of pooled 2 g leaf

prompt: Optimising ribosome profiling in Arabidopsis: RNase I vs MNase digestion on 8-day-old Col-0 seedlings grown on MS plates. Replicate libraries per method?
paper_design: RNase I vs MNase digestion comparison, seedlings

prompt: Zebrafish embryos at 36 hpf: I want to sort endothelial cells, hemogenic endothelium and HSPCs and run whole-genome bisulfite sequencing on each cell type. How many replicates per cell type?
paper_design: sorted EC/HE/HSC, WGBS, 6 samples each
